title: Nirbhay
desc: After a mother abandons her child and leaves him in an orphanage, he is falsely accused of two murders and faces jail term. After he walks out of prison, he seeks revenge from the culprits.

title: Shaan
desc: Two brothers go after the international mafia kingpin who murdered their cop brother. They are later joined by another man who wants revenge against the gangster.

title: Tum Haseen Main Jawan
desc: A navy officer who has had a number of affairs with attractive young women meets a beautiful girl and falls in love. Though she loves him in return, another admirer of hers tells the officer that she is deceiving him and is the mother of a child.

title: Ek Hassina Do Deewane
desc: Amar, an orthodox businessman marries Neeta; slowly he starts mentally torturing her which leads to their divorce. Amar makes a deal with Neeta before filing for a divorce. Will she agree?
